reply_text:
I wouldn't merge `excerpt-helper` yet. It has one real bug, the new helpers aren't used by the card yet, and a few smaller problems. I didn't change anything. I read the diff against `main` and ran the helpers on some edge cases.

**Blocking**

1. **`excerpt` always adds an ellipsis, even when nothing was cut.** `excerpt('hi', 10)` returns `"hi…"`. The README says short text comes back unchanged and the ellipsis only appears when text was removed, but the code never compares the text length to `limit`. It needs an early return like `if (trimmed.length <= limit) return trimmed;`. The only test uses a long string, so it doesn't catch this. A test with short text would.

2. **Neither helper is connected to the card.** `src/card.js` is unchanged and still returns the full `body.trim()`. Nothing calls `excerpt` or `toPlain`. So the preview text under each card won't change on merge, even though the version is bumped to 1.5.0 and the changelog says "Card body excerpts." If wiring them into the card is meant to be a separate step, I'd hold the version bump and changelog entry until then.

**Should fix**

3. **Cuts at the limit lose a word.** `lastSpaceBefore` only looks at the first `limit` characters, so it misses a space sitting exactly at the limit. `excerpt('the quick brown', 9)` returns `"the…"` when `"the quick…"` fits. The README promises a cut "at or before the limit", so it should search `text.slice(0, limit + 1)`.

4. **`toPlain` strips characters it shouldn't, and misses some it should.**
   - It removes every `*`, `_`, `~` and backtick anywhere in the text, so `my_var_name` becomes `myvarname`, and code and math text get damaged too.
   - Images come out as `!img` instead of the alt text.
   - Heading `#` signs, list markers and `>` quotes are left in.

   For example, `toPlain('use my_var_name ![img](a.png) # Title')` gives `"use myvarname !img # Title"`.

**Minor**

5. **Very short limits.** If a single word is longer than `limit`, the cut lands in the middle of the word (no space falls back to `limit`). That's fine, but it should be written down. Also, the ellipsis makes the result one character longer than `limit`. Check that the card layout allows for that.
6. **Unrelated changelog edit.** The 1.4.0 entry was reworded ("a title and body"). It's harmless, but it isn't part of this change.
7. **Thin tests.** There's one test per file. Worth adding: short text unchanged, text exactly at the limit, a space right at the limit, no spaces at all, empty or whitespace-only text, and underscores inside words for `toPlain`.

Fixing items 1 and 2 is what makes this branch do what it says. Items 3 and 4 will show up as odd previews soon after.
